title: Remote machines
description: Let the agent work directly on another machine, without installing Pisper there. Models and API keys stay on this computer.
removeDescription: Sessions on this machine will no longer be able to run tools, and its saved password, if any, is deleted. Files on that machine are not affected.
form.targetPlaceholder: user@host or an SSH config alias
form.passwordKeep: A password is saved; leave empty to keep it
form.name: Name
form.keyHint: Signs in with this computer's existing SSH config and keys. Pisper stores no passwords or private keys.
form.passwordHint: The password is stored on this computer, readable only by your account, and is never shown again. Key sign-in is safer: nothing secret is stored here and it can't be guessed. Machines that also ask for a one-time code are not supported.
pair.description: For machines without an SSH service: that machine connects to this computer, so no open port and no Pisper install. It only needs Node.js 20 or later.
pair.remoteOff: Remote access is off, so that machine can't reach this computer. Turn on remote access above, then generate the commands again.
pair.rootHint: Replace the folder with where work is allowed. You can pass --root several times. The agent can only work inside these folders.
failure.refused: Connection refused: that machine may not be running an SSH service, or the port is wrong. For machines without SSH, use "Let a machine connect here".
failure.unreachable: Can't reach that machine. Check the address, network and firewall.
failure.auth: That machine has an SSH service but refused the sign-in. Add this computer's public key to authorized_keys there, or edit the machine to sign in with a password.
failure.authPassword: That machine refused the user name or password, or it doesn't accept password sign-in. Check them, or use key sign-in.
failure.hostKey: That machine's host key changed, so the connection was refused for safety. If it was reinstalled, update known_hosts on this computer first.
failure.clientMissing: The ssh command isn't available on this computer. Install the OpenSSH client first.
failure.timeout: That machine took too long to respond.
failure.invalidTarget: The address must be user@host, host, or an SSH config alias.
failure.invalidPort: The port must be a whole number from 1 to 65535.
failure.folderMissing: That folder doesn't exist on the other machine.
failure.outsideRoots: That folder is outside what the other machine allows.
failure.offline: This machine is offline. Run npx pisper executor on it.
failure.tooMany: You can add up to 32 machines.
failure.generic: The connection to that machine failed.
